Depth to space: trade channels for resolution.

Rearranges channels into a larger sample (PyTorch PixelShuffle): the channel count must be divisible by the square of the upscale factor. Runs on ArrayFire.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Upsampling](../categories/upsampling.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | pixel, shuffle, subpixel, upsample |
